messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High token surge & errors observed for model heron-13b in prod-us-east-1. TPM 1m spike = 4.2x baseline, 429 rate rising. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat

maya (oncall): i'm on it — is this mostly 429s or also 5xx?

aj: mostly 429/403 from quota checks, a few 500s in runtime (kv cache pressure)

maya (oncall): paging SRE oncall: @tory @leah pls take

tory: grabbing dashboards — link: https://dash.reed/internal/heron-13b?range=15m

mike (runtime): seeing heavy long-prefix traffic (LLMs with long context). batching isn't helping since requests are diverse

maya (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) emergency reduce TPM/RPM for heron-13b, 2) disable function-calling for heron-13b to cut downstream tool load, 3) redirect non-critical/non-auth traffic to wren-7b  (small model) while we stabilize

aj: agreed. propose numbers: TPM -> 1800 (from ~7000), RPM -> 6000 (from ~25k)

maya (oncall): applying carveout via admin API now — will post exact command

maya (oncall): ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.reed/api/v1/quota/change -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"heron-13b","tpm":1800,"rpm":6000,"reason":"emergency surge - reduce to protect cluster"}'
```

sre-runbook-bot: runbook step executed: quota_change invoked by maya (id: run-2026-330555)

leah (prod-eng): also enabling per-customer soft caps for top tenants hitting heron-13b to avoid noisy-neighbor impact

maya (oncall): did we toggle function-calling off in prod? need to notify CS (some customers rely on tools)

mike (runtime): yes — pushed toggle: `feature.toggle(\'heron-13b\', \'funcall\', false)` and warmed config cache

aj: routing change to steer anonymous/non-auth traffic to wren-7b. applying rule now:
```json
{"selector":"/v1/generate","filter":"anonymous","route_to":"wren-7b","ratio":0.75}
```

maya (oncall): note on customer impact: tool-enabled tenants will see degraded tool behavior; we've queued CS notifications for high-value customers

customer-success-bot: CS alert queued: incident 3305557777 - template: "Heron-13b traffic shaping in place, some tool features limited. Working on rollback criteria."

tory: monitoring health. rollback criteria proposed: 1) 15m rolling 429 rate < 1% AND 2) P95 latency < 600ms for 15m

maya (oncall): ack. I'll coordinate rollback and postmortem. capturing sample prompts to check quality deviation after routing shift

aj: immediate infra effect: GPU util dropped from ~65% -> ~45% on impacted pool, headroom now ~4 nodes (estimated)

leah (prod-eng): leaving ops note to run Optimize recommendations for heron-13b defaults once stable — current defaults too aggressive for mixed workloads

maya (oncall): thanks team. watching for 1h. if 429s come back, plan B = per-customer circuit-breaker + increase reserve capacity

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared for oncall

mike (runtime): i'll drop a short ops doc in #docs-ops with the exact API calls, timestamps, and observed metrics

maya (oncall): thx all. tagging for incident review: owner=maya, severity=sev2, mitigation=quota+routing+feature-toggle. end thread.
